description: Capability-aware artifact delivery. Checks if the target IO interface supports file/image upload and delivers appropriately - either as a file attachment or as a text reference with blob IDs. Use this when delivering generated images, files, or other artifacts from async jobs.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Delivers generated artifacts to the user's IO interface.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: SessionError: Invalid or expired session_id. JobNotFound: The job_result_ref does not exist or has no artifacts. DeliveryError: Artifact could not be delivered to the interface.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For session errors: verify the session_id is current. For job errors: verify the job completed successfully. For delivery errors: the artifact may still be accessible via blob reference.
